updates.title: CVE-2026-83711: Azure AD B2C Authorization Bypass Vulnerability
updates.summary: A critical authorization bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Azure Active Directory B2C allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges through user-controlled keys. Admins should apply security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized access to B2C tenants and customer identities.

updates.title: CVE-2026-70352: Azure AI Language Missing Authentication Vulnerability
updates.summary: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure AI Language exposes a privilege escalation vulnerability that an unauthorized attacker can exploit over the network. Admins managing AI services integrated with identity platforms should review and update affected systems promptly.

updates.title: Enhanced sAM Account Name Support for Microsoft Entra Domain Services
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Domain Services now supports synchronizing the Security Accounts Manager account name (sAMAccountName) from the onPremisesSamAccountName attribute in Microsoft Entra ID, improving hybrid identity synchronization for on-premises and cloud scenarios. This feature is in public preview and enabled by default for new managed domains, giving admins more control over legacy application authentication.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview RMS Connector: Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, enhancing security posture. Admins must configure their own Microsoft Entra app registration and certificate using new PowerShell cmdlets to manage the upgrade for Connector, Exchange, SharePoint, and FCI workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft connected applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This expands DLP governance beyond the Microsoft ecosystem to cover hybrid SaaS environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now be created for non-Microsoft connected applications including Box and Google Workspace, applying the same classification engine used for Microsoft 365 locations. Admins can extend data protection and governance strategies across third-party cloud storage platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode before enforcement to preview which items would be labeled without making actual changes. The new Insights tab in the policy details panel displays real-time performance metrics and match results to help admins validate policy readiness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard displays Mean Time to Acknowledge (MTTA), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) SLA metrics for DLP alerts, showing trends and top exposed sensitive information types. Admins can define custom SLAs by severity level and monitor operational compliance performance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard allows admins to monitor device health across their entire estate and verify readiness for policy updates, while quickly identifying devices that are not compliant or unable to receive policies. This visibility improves Endpoint DLP deployment reliability and policy rollout planning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Scalability and Policy Management Enhancements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is expanding auto-labeling support for larger SharePoint scopes with improved policy management flexibility and richer visibility into labeling activity across enterprise-scale deployments. These enhancements enable better label policy validation and monitoring in complex multi-tenant environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection File Labeler for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are now available on macOS, providing parity with Windows capabilities and allowing Mac users to label, view, and protect files consistently. Advanced label-based protection features are not yet available on the macOS version.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Default Protection Controls for Classification Failure
updates.summary: Admins can now create granular DLP policies for Exchange Online based on specific classification failure types such as timeouts and throttling, rather than applying a blanket policy for all failures. This public preview feature enables more precise handling of edge cases during content classification.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Azure PST Import
updates.summary: A new Azure PST Import method enables direct migration of PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes, following a standard two-step process with analysis and execution phases. This simplifies large-scale mailbox migration and archive management for compliance and data lifecycle scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Archive Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB Limit
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now grow beyond the previous 1.5 TB hard limit, ensuring continuous retention capability and scalable storage as thresholds are reached. This capability is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses and prevents mailbox inoperability due to storage constraints.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Scanner Data Export for Custom Reporting
updates.summary: Admins can now export information protection scanner data to create custom reports on labeling, classification, and protection actions across scanned repositories stored in SQL tables. This enables tailored compliance reporting and visibility into information protection effectiveness.
